findings.title: priority field missing from POST /tickets request schema and error codes
findings.description: The diff adds a required 'priority' field to POST /tickets (accepted values LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH; case-insensitive; stored as upper case) and a new error code 'invalid_priority'. Neither the request field table nor the error codes table in docs/api.md was updated. A caller following the documentation would not know to send priority and would receive a 500 (or 400) without explanation.
findings.evidence: Code: priority = priority.upper()  (sample-project/app/service.py:47)  |  Doc: no mention of 'priority' in POST /tickets section (docs/api.md lines 36-62)
findings.recommendation: Add 'priority' to the POST /tickets request body table (required, string, one of LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH, case-insensitive). Add a row to the error codes table: 400 | invalid_priority | priority is missing, null, or not one of LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH. Update the response example to include the priority field. Update the curl example to pass priority.

limitations: OpenAPI schema does not expose manually raised ValidationError codes (invalid_priority); source file was read directly to identify missing error documentation.
